tasks.name: dd-prepare
command: import json, sys; from run_scripts.bernstein.run_dd_bernstein_332 import Configuration, snapshot_configuration; snapshot_configuration(Configuration(**json.loads(sys.argv[1])))

tasks.name: dd-aggregate
command: import json, sys; from run_scripts.bernstein.run_dd_bernstein_332 import Configuration, run_fold, aggregate; c = Configuration(**json.loads(sys.argv[1])); [run_fold(c, f) for f in c.folds]; aggregate(c)

tasks.name: multidim-aggregate
command: import sys; from run_scripts.common.run_compirt_game_holdout import aggregate_folds; aggregate_folds(sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]))
